0022600206.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-4, 2-1 at home, third in the Atlantic and 5th in the East) host the Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 4-0 on the road, third in the Southwest and 7th in the West), who come in on a three-game losing streak. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), while Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (out, knee bruise), Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Raptors won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3.
